children: Trilogy Metals was named to the 2026 TSX30 after its dividend-adjusted share price rose 570% over the three years ended June 30, 2026.
Announced inclusion in the 2026 TSX30, a ranking of top TSX performers over three years.
Trilogy Metals' dividend-adjusted share price appreciated 570% for the three years ended June 30, 2026.
Company attributes recognition to investor confidence and strategic importance of the Arctic Project to U.S. critical mineral supply chains.
Trilogy remains focused on advancing the Ambler Mining District projects through permitting and development with joint-venture partner Ambler Metals.
